activity-01.title: Activity 01 · Micro-fictions
activity-01.intro: Explore short-form storytelling in conversation with a language model. Begin with some structure, then loosen the reins: take detours and bend the output into something unexpected, and possibly a little strange. Don’t aim for polish or perfection. Stay curious, test boundaries, and see what emerges.
steps: The machine writes the first line. After that, take turns, one line at a time: yours, then the machine’s.
Add your creative twist. Use your turn to shift or disrupt the story: derail the plot, contradict the machine, or throw in something sudden.
Use your wild words. Draw a wild card and include at least one of its words or phrases in your story. The machine will work in a different one.
There are no edits. Once a line is written, it’s permanent.
The story ends at {maxWords} words. Download it, or press New story to try again.
activity-01.note: Want company? Pair up and share one device, taking turns.

activity-02.title: Activity 02 · Visual Poetry
activity-02.intro: Move from storytelling to text arrangement. Build compositions from machine-generated words that are as much about rhythm and layout as they are about language. Don’t aim for a finished poem. Stay curious and see what the arrangement says.
steps: Start with a phrase. A feeling, an object, a question, or something from earlier. Generate again for more; they pile up.
Place your words. Click one to put it on the canvas and drag it around. Click it again, or press Remove, to take it off.
Let the layout do the talking. Scale, color, space, and placement are your expressive tools. Select a word to change them.
Describe your colors. Tap the dot to pick one, type a hex code, or say it in words (“burnt orange”) and the machine will choose.
Fill the gaps. Leave the phrase blank for filler words like “the” and “of” when your poem needs some glue.
Share it. Download your poem, or press Send to screen to show it to the room. Your name goes with it, and you can send more than one. Refresh the page to start again.
activity-02.note: You may want to go fullscreen to work more comfortably.

activity-03.title: Activity 03 · Temp Check
activity-03.intro: A game for the whole room about how predictable the machine is.
steps: The host shows a sentence with a blank, here and on the big screen.
When the clock starts, type one word to fill the blank. You only get a few seconds.
Meanwhile the machine fills in the same blank again and again.
Be the machine: you score by how often the machine says your word. Beat the machine: you score 100 if neither the machine nor anyone else said your word.
Temperature decides how adventurous the machine is. Watch what happens to its answers as it rises.
